name: Deadmines
summary: Beneath ruined Moonbrook, the Deadmines lie quiet, though rumors speak of danger in their forgotten shafts. Once the greatest gold producer in human lands, the mines fell silent during the First War.

sections.title: A Vein of Gold and Blood
sections.body:
Gold once poured from the Deadmines, the richest mines in human lands. Whitestone oak supplied their timber and supports. When the orcish Horde pushed north, the miners fled in haste.

During the First War, Sir Anduin Lothar entered the treacherous depths to recover the sacred Tome of Divinity. Subterranean ogres held him captive for twenty months before rescuers freed him. After the kingdom fell, the shafts went quiet, and people came to say they were cursed.

sections.title: VanCleef's Foundry
sections.body:
After Stormwind's stonemasons rioted, the newly formed Defias Brotherhood made the Deadmines its chief refuge. Stormwind's Miners' League tried to reopen the tunnels under Foreman Thistlenettle. Defias brigands ambushed the workers and collapsed the shafts, and the slain miners now wander as restless undead.

Ogre enforcers and goblin tinkerers guard the deep tunnels. There, around a shipyard in Ironclad Cove, the Defias have built an industrial war camp.

faq.q: How do you get into the Deadmines?
faq.answer: The main entrance lies inside the Defias Hideout in ruined Moonbrook, in southwestern Westfall. Wind down through the basements to reach the mine shafts.

faq.q: Why were the mines abandoned in the first place?
faq.answer: The mines fell silent during the First War, when the Horde overran the kingdom's southern regions. War raged and ogres moved into the depths, ending the mining work. The empty tunnels soon gained a reputation for being haunted.

faq.q: What is the Defias Brotherhood building down here?
faq.answer: Edwin VanCleef and hired goblin engineers are building an enormous ironclad juggernaught in the flooded cavern of Ironclad Cove. VanCleef means to sail it up the coast and bombard and besiege Stormwind City in retribution.

faq.q: Who are the undead wandering near the entrance tunnels?
aliases: why are there ghouls in deadmines
faq.answer: The undead are Miners' League workers led by Foreman Thistlenettle. Defias thugs ambushed the League as it tried to survey and reclaim the mine, then collapsed the shafts. The trapped miners died and rose as restless ghouls.

faq.q: What connection does Anduin Lothar have to the Deadmines?
faq.answer: During the First War, Sir Anduin Lothar journeyed deep into the Deadmines to retrieve the sacred Tome of Divinity. Ogres in the caverns captured him and held him for nearly two years before he was rescued.

angles.text: As a paladin, you share a holy history with the Deadmines. During the First War, Sir Anduin Lothar entered their darkest chambers to recover the sacred Tome of Divinity from savage ogres.
As a miner, you walk where human mining once reached its height. Before the First War, the Deadmines led all human lands in gold production. Goblin machinery and Defias outlaws later took over.
